project_type: Flutter mobile app (live location sharing with Firebase backend)
build_system: Flutter SDK + Gradle (Android). Flutter is NOT pre-installed in sandbox and must be installed first.
test_framework: flutter_test (single widget_test.dart that is a default counter test - not functional for this app)
verification_instructions: 1. Install Flutter SDK. 2. Run 'flutter pub get' to resolve dependencies. 3. Run 'flutter analyze' and confirm no errors (warnings/infos acceptable). 4. Run 'flutter test' if tests exist.
setup_instructions: 1. Download Flutter SDK (stable channel). 2. Add to PATH. 3. Run 'flutter pub get' in project root.
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET network mode. Flutter is NOT pre-installed. Must download and install Flutter SDK. No Android SDK/emulator available so cannot do flutter build apk, but flutter analyze works without it.
contribution_requirements: No CONTRIBUTING.md found. Project is a personal Flutter project.
key_patterns: Singleton managers (GroupsManager, UsersManager, Groups2Manager, ThemeManager). Firebase Realtime Database for data. Cloud Firestore used in newer code (CloudFirebaseHelper). Direct HTTP calls to Firebase REST API in some places. Google Sign-In for auth. Provider for state management. Route management via RoutesHelper with named routes.
directory_structure: lib/ - all Dart source. lib/core/ - data models (OldUser, Group, Location, UserLocation). lib/model/ - newer models (DocItem, Group2, TrovUser, userModel). lib/managers/ - singleton managers. lib/helpers/ - route helper, cloud firebase helper. lib/httpClient/ - HTTP client wrapper. android/ - Android project. test/ - single widget test. assets/ - images.
